fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a weak winter season and business anxiety in the Greater Miami area; criticism of Miami Herald classified advertising practices and discussion of labor/union issues; coverage of municipal services and crime statistics, court and legal-process commentary, and traffic/transportation concerns. Also includes a lengthy health article arguing for cancer prevention and linking tobacco smoke to cancer, along with entertainment listings and local notices.
